source_user: A service receives a mix of short prompts and long generations. Design an evaluation plan that reports TTFT, TPOT, throughput, queueing, and P99 latency. Scenario variant 273: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: separate prefill and decode behavior; fix workload distribution; report warmup; use repeated trials; capture GPU memory and request-level traces.
corrected_answer:
For scenario variant 1273, compare a candidate serving configuration with a fixed baseline using randomized, paired replay of an immutable request trace. Declare model/tokenizer, precision, hardware, software build, scheduler, routing, batching, admission, autoscaling, clock synchronization, cache state, and instrumentation assumptions; log deviations rather than inventing platform facts. Fix and publish the short/long prompt and requested-output distributions, stratify by input and output token counts, offered load or concurrency, and cache state, and predeclare random seeds, warm-up exclusion, at least five independent paired repetitions, exclusion/stopping rules, and a correctness oracle.

Hypothesis: in every prespecified load stratum, the candidate increases correct SLO-goodput by at least 10% while error rate and end-to-end P99 latency rise by no more than 5%. Treat the hypothesis as unsupported when paired confidence bounds fail either threshold. Capture synchronized ingress, admission, queue release, prefill start/end, first-token, per-token decode, completion, timeout, cancellation, retry, and correctness events. Report queue-inclusive and compute-only TTFT, TPOT as decode time divided by a declared generated-token denominator (and state handling of empty/failed outputs), request and output-token throughput, queue-wait distributions, and end-to-end P50/P95/P99 latency; separately report prefill and decode timing.

For each stratum, retain raw traces and trial-level summaries, error categories, timeout/cancellation/retry counts, correctness failures, and confidence intervals. Correlate GPU memory/KV-cache occupancy, utilization, clocks, power, temperature, CPU, host-memory, network, and admission/queue telemetry with latency; record saturation, OOM, throttling, drift, and instrumentation loss as failures or exclusions with reasons. Control model version, data, traffic shape, concurrency, background load, cache state, and thermal conditions; randomize order and repeat after warm-up. Validate the oracle and timestamps before interpreting results. Roll out only through a small canary with SLO, correctness, error-rate, P99, OOM, thermal, and saturation gates; automatically stop and restore the baseline on any gate breach. Results remain provisional and require expert review.

Report queue-inclusive and compute-only TTFT, TPOT as decode time divided by a declared generated-token denominator (and state handling of empty/failed outputs), request and output-token throughput, queue-wait distributions, and end-to-end P50/P95/P99 latency; separately report prefill and decode timing.

For each stratum, retain raw traces and trial-level summaries, error categories, timeout/cancellation/retry counts, correctness failures, and confidence intervals. Correlate GPU memory/KV-cache occupancy, utilization, clocks, power, temperature, CPU, host-memory, network, and admission/queue telemetry with latency; record saturation, OOM, throttling, drift, and instrumentation loss as failures or exclusions with reasons. Control model version, data, traffic shape, concurrency, background load, cache state, and thermal conditions; randomize order and repeat after warm-up. Validate the oracle and timestamps before interpreting results. Roll out only through a small canary with SLO, correctness, error-rate, P99, OOM, thermal, and saturation gates; automatically stop and restore the baseline on any gate breach. Results remain provisional and require expert review.

quality_dimensions.coverage: covers assumptions, mechanisms, boundaries, failure modes, measurements, evidence, and safety limits
quality_dimensions.technical_correctness: separates prefill/decode and queue effects and defines serving metrics and denominators
quality_dimensions.falsifiability: uses prespecified goodput, error-rate, and P99 thresholds
quality_dimensions.operational_safety: requires staged canary, observability, and rollback gates
quality_dimensions.evidence_quality: requires raw traces, telemetry, configuration, correctness records, and uncertainty analysis

risks: Synthetic scenario omits platform-specific scheduler, tokenizer, or observability constraints.
Matched replay may underrepresent live burstiness, cache effects, and autoscaling.
Percentile estimates are uncertain with too few or correlated repetitions.
A flawed correctness oracle can invalidate goodput and error conclusions.
evidence_required: Paired statistical analysis with uncertainty and exclusion log
